description: A single-channel touch controller with a gate output and two offsets: dragging the pad sets a level, and the output slides to that level at a rate you choose

params.text: Drag to set the level, 0V at the bottom and 10V at the top, which the output then slides to at the rate set by RATE
An attenuverter setting the range of the CV output: at full right the pad gives 0-10V, at full left 0 to -10V
Transition time of the CV, from 0 for an instant jump to 4 seconds per volt; turning it during a transition changes the rate of the transition under way
In the top position a slide is exponential, in the bottom position linear
An offset of -10V to 10V added to the CV output after the attenuverter
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, on the OFST2 input before it is added to the CV output
Triples the rate knob, taking it to 12 seconds per volt for slower transitions

inputs.text: A voltage at or above 1V holds the gate output high, which is how several of these modules are chained
A voltage added to the CV output through the OFST2 attenuverter, for offsetting the level from another source

outputs.text: The control voltage set by the pad, after the attenuverter and both offsets, clamped to -10V to 10V
10V while the pad is being held with the mouse, or while the chain input is at or above 1V, and 0V otherwise

menu: Rate knob x3 (max 12 s/V) — stretches the rate knob to 12 seconds per volt, matching the x3 switch
Auto-return — sends the level back to a chosen percentage of the pad's range when the mouse button is released; Off (default) leaves the level where it was put

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
